name: pink-neon-sporty-fashion
image_purpose: modern sportswear campaign and lookbook image

prompt.project_info: Create a vibrant sportswear fashion editorial with a pink and light-purple neon gradient studio background.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional female fashion model with original non-celebrity features stands in a confident power pose wearing a white-and-pink cropped windbreaker jacket, a white mini skirt with secure fashion coverage, knee-high white socks, and clean generic sneakers.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body centered studio composition, minimal background, white-and-pink sporty streetwear styling, strong vertical silhouette, clean commercial campaign framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft studio glow with pink and light-purple neon gradient illumination, glossy but realistic skin and fabric, vibrant modern sportswear campaign mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-fashion editorial photography, sharp focus, bold composition, realistic textile and sneaker detail, ultra-detailed 4K-style output, no visible watermark or rendered text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Fashion editorial photograph of an adult fictional female model with original non-celebrity features standing in a confident power pose, wearing a white-and-pink cropped windbreaker jacket, a white mini skirt with secure fashion coverage, knee-high white socks, and clean generic sneakers.
